subject: Application for AI / ML Engineer
body: I am an AI/ML Engineer with ~1.5 years of experience shipping machine learning systems that deliver measurable business results. At Brain Hub Technologies I designed and deployed stock-prediction models that contributed to a ~30% increase in trading revenue, and as a developer for Al-Safeena I built a home-services marketplace that drove ~40% revenue growth for a Saudi Arabian client. I am applying for the AI/ML Engineer role at Acme AI Labs because [reason tied to the company/mission].

My work spans the full ML lifecycle: fine-tuning LLMs with LoRA (Qwen2.5-3B on scientific QA data, with hallucination analysis), building production computer-vision systems (YOLO11 + ByteTrack video analytics with event engines and FastAPI serving), and engineering tabular models tuned with Optuna that reached 0.97094 on a Kaggle leaderboard. I co-authored a study on Generative AI adoption published in an HEC-recognized journal, and I apply the same rigor to every pipeline I build.

I would welcome the chance to discuss how my experience building and deploying ML systems end-to-end can contribute to [specific outcome/team goal]. My resume is attached, and I am available for an interview at your convenience.
Thank you for your time and consideration.
